name: EarthBound Recomp
summary: Early EarthBound native-port bring-up with interpreter fallback, privately built from the exact USA original.

presentation.manual_preparation: Supply the exact headerless raw USA SNES original. Core builds the pinned early EarthBound prototype privately with the Python HiROM analysis and SDL2 backends; launcher, mods, netplay, tracing and co-simulation are disabled. The owned game.sfc and fixed arguments are required. Remove SDL_DYNAMIC_API before starting Portcove. Configuration/keybindings, rom.cfg and saves use Core persistence; run/coverage/crash diagnostics are mutable outputs. Actual private Core build, 12-file verification, two startup/ordinary-close cycles, pinned current-version maintenance, four-file backup/restore and consent-bound owned removal passed at the recorded qualification CLI. A different source release requires a reviewed compatible recipe. Upstream title/file-select bring-up is not full-game acceptance. Installed Desktop, protected production delivery, binary redistribution, gameplay/save-load, visual/audio/controller and other-platform observations remain unqualified. See docs/qualification/earthbound-fixed-source-2026-10-19.md for exact scopes.
